profile.role_note: An off-field coordinated-attack specialist. Her Outro buffs the next ally's Glacio DMG and Resonance Skill DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A premium but niche sub-DPS. Pull her only if you run Resonance Skill carries like Carlotta, Jinhsi, or Changli. That is where her Glacio and Skill Outro buffs, and her off-field coordinated attacks, shine. Otherwise, skip her for a more all-round unit.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Rime-Draped Sprouts + 5-piece Empyrean Anthem in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Nightmare: Lampylumen Myriad in the main slot. Run Crit Rate/DMG on the 4-cost. Use two Glacio DMG pieces on the 3-costs — swap one to Energy Regen if her Liberation is not ready each rotation. Use ATK% on the 1-costs. Keep a 1:2 Crit ratio.

ranked_weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. It gives an ATK boost, plus a stacking Basic Attack DMG Bonus. On Outro, that converts into a 52% off-field Basic Attack DMG buff. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: An all-round 5-star stick. It has a Crit Rate substat and stacking ATK. It also gives bonus ATK while she is off-field. Very strong on her.

ranked_weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
ranked_weapons.note: Near-signature stats, with Basic Attack DMG Bonus stacks. But the effect is conditional, and tied to Echo Skill use.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: An F2P-friendly 5-star from the Strongbox. It gives Energy Regen and ATK, plus a stacking Basic Attack DMG Bonus. It sits about 14% behind her signature.

echo_sets.name: Empyrean Anthem
echo_sets.note: A huge coordinated-attack DMG boost. It also gives Energy Regen, plus an ATK buff for the on-field carry when she lands Crit hits. Her new best set — it needs steady Crit Rate.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: A support-focused set. It gives a 22.5% ATK buff to the next Resonator on Outro, plus Energy Regen. Good if nobody else is holding it.

echo_sets.name: Freezing Frost
echo_sets.note: The max personal damage option, if Zhezhi is your on-field main DPS. All her hits count as Basic Attack DMG, so she triggers it easily.

stat_priorities.note: Whichever balances her to a 1:2 Crit ratio. Empyrean Anthem wants steady Crit Rate to keep its ATK buff up.
Two Glacio DMG pieces is best. Swap one to Energy Regen if her Liberation is not ready each rotation.

build.energy_regen_target: 116-150% (sources disagree: Prydwen lists 116-128%, thegamer.com supports 150%; build toward comfortable Liberation uptime)
build.weapon_filler_note: 4-star stopgaps include Radiant Dawn and Fusion Accretion (both buff her on Resonance Skill), Augment (ATK on Liberation), and Variation (Concerto Energy). 3-star fallback: Guardian Rectifier.

teams.name: Premium: Carlotta + Zhezhi + Shorekeeper

members.name: Carlotta
members.note: Glacio carry whose damage lives in her Resonance Skill — Zhezhi's Outro buffs both Glacio and Resonance Skill DMG.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Sets up coordinated attacks with Liberation, then Outros into Carlotta for the full buff package.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm, team Crit buffs, and healing; her Crit Rate boost keeps Zhezhi's Empyrean Anthem ATK buff active.

teams.rotation: Carlotta starts, building Resonance Skill stacks. Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm and buffs. Zhezhi runs a quick combo: Resonance Skills, her Forte burst, then her Liberation, to leave coordinated attacks running. She Outros into Carlotta's full burst window, with off-field support still active.

teams.name: Budget: Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Verina

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Spectro burst carry; Zhezhi's coordinated attacks feed Jinhsi's Incandescence stacks while the Resonance Skill Outro buffs her rotation.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Coordinated attacks plus a Resonance Energy transfer to the next ally via her passive.

members.name: Verina
members.note: F2P-friendly sustain: team ATK buff and healing with low field-time requirements.

teams.rotation: Verina opens. She builds Concerto and buffs ATK. Zhezhi builds Forte and casts her Liberation for coordinated attacks. Then she Outros, passing her buffs and Energy to Jinhsi. Jinhsi finishes with her full Incandescence-boosted Liberation combo.

teams.name: Alternative: Lingyang + Zhezhi + Verina

members.name: Lingyang
members.note: Glacio DPS who uses every part of Zhezhi's Outro — both the Glacio and Resonance Skill DMG buffs.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Fast on-field setup and coordinated-attack uptime that matches Lingyang's quick pace.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing and ATK buff; opens rotations to charge Concerto quickly.

teams.rotation: Verina opens with her Resonance Skill and Liberation, to buff the team. Zhezhi fills her Concerto with Basic Attacks and Resonance Skills. She casts her Liberation for coordinated attacks. Then she swaps to Lingyang, who takes the field with the full Glacio and Skill DMG package active.

tier_badge.label: Strong niche Sub-DPS
tier_badge.note: Current v3.6-3.7 lists all place her at A. Older 1.x-era lists had her at S. Her ceiling rises on Glacio and Tower of Adversity cycles that favour her.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete kit for her Glacio support role. Aim for S1 first — it funds her own Liberation. S3 is the big mid stop. S6 is only for on-field damage builds.

pull_path.why: Full support kit — Outro buffs and coordinated attacks work with no dupes.
Creation’s Zenith restores 15 Resonance Energy and adds 10% Crit Rate for 27s — she funds her own Liberation.
+15% ATK for 27s stacking 3 times (up to +45%) on every Skill version — her biggest mid stop.
Extra Ivory Herald for 120% Skill DMG on every Skill cast — the on-field damage capstone.
